facts.fact: The Fondation Tunisie pour le Developpement says its ELIFE network has six operational technology centres offering coworking, startup incubation and certified digital training, with Sidi Bouzid opened 16 June 2026 and Tozeur 17 June 2026.
The document says the six operational ELIFE centres are in Sidi Bouzid, Tozeur, Siliana, Beja, Le Kef and Djerba.
